findings: Symbol/digit criterion not gated at submit — handleRegister() blocks on password.length < 10 and !passwordHasUpperCase but not on !passwordHasSymbol. A MEDIUM password (10 chars + uppercase, no symbol/digit) passes. Either add an errorPasswordNoSymbol check, or update register_password_requirements to reflect only the two enforced rules.

Phone validation threshold too low — the click-time check blocks on phone.length < 7. The EG +20 chip implies Egyptian numbers (10 digits minimum). A 7-character input passes. Raise the threshold to at least 10.

Lock icon on Personal Credentials header — PersonalCredentialsCard uses Icons.Rounded.Lock for its section header, the same icon as the Account Security card. Icons.Rounded.Person (already imported for the name-field leading icon) would better identify this section.
